entities.summary: Winford Gladstone Boynes III is an American former professional basketball player. Born in Greenville, South Carolina, he was a 6-foot-6-inch (198 cm) 185 pounds (84 kg) guard and played collegiately at the University of San Francisco from 1975–1978.
